News highlights 11th November 2026
LOCAL NEWS🇱🇰

Cabinet approves $ 200 m ADB financing for MSME financial sector development
The Cabinet of Ministers has approved entering into financing agreements with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to secure $ 200 million for a sector development program aimed at strengthening access to finance for micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs).

Cabinet awards Rs. 9.1 b road contracts for highway upgrades, Ditwah recovery
The Cabinet of Ministers has approved four road development and rehabilitation contracts worth Rs. 9.1 billion, covering national highway improvements and the restoration of roads damaged by Cyclone Ditwah.
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/3avnkh87

Sri Lanka hopes to fully utilize LKR 2,000.0Bn capital spending next year
The Sri Lankan government has adjusted its procurement cycles for development projects with the hope of utilizing the full LKR 2,000.0Bn capital expenditure planned for next year, Cabinet Spokesman Nalinda Jayatissa said.
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/4wfm5r7x

No electricity tariff revision for fourth quarter of 2026: PUCSL
The Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) yesterday announced that it has decided to maintain existing electricity tariffs for the final quarter of 2026, despite a 2.88% increase in the cost of electricity supply.
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/38yxspjv

SL invests Rs 1 b to boost dairy industry
Sri Lanka is investing Rs 1 billion in the livestock sector under the 2026 National Budget, with the National Livestock Development Board (NLDB) advancing a major programme aimed at strengthening domestic dairy production, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, according to the Department of Government Information (DGI) yesterday (10).
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/bdzb96nz

Sri Lanka’s poorest fifth lose 16% of real household income
Sri Lanka’s poorest fifth of households lost 16.4 percent of their average monthly income in real terms between 2016 and early 2025, while the richest fifth gained 16.5 percent, widening the income gap, as poverty returned to its level of nine years earlier.
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/yc2v5ehd

Global News 🌎
Recent Ukrainian attacks have reduced Russia's oil processing capacity by 30%, sources say
Renewed Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian oil refineries since late October have reduced Russia's oil refining capacity by about 30%, two industry sources said.
Reference - https://tinyurl.com/vvdcwbb5

LNG Traffic Through Hormuz Hits Highest Level Since Iran War Began
Exports of liquefied natural gas via the Strait of Hormuz last month reached the highest total since February, at 31 tankers, compared with 27 in September, according to data from Kpler, as cited by Reuters.
